records.question: Can Supabase provide the four required auth identity types for the React Native reference adapter?
records.applicableRange: Current Supabase Auth documentation checked 2026-07-22; exact package versions remain an H1/preflight decision
records.conclusion: Supabase Auth supports email, phone, Google and Apple flows. Native social providers can exchange provider ID tokens for a Supabase session, while redirect-based flows require native deep-link configuration.
records.contradiction: A successful OAuth UI does not by itself prove the expected backend session or identity, and a browser callback does not remove the need for native lifecycle testing.
records.enforcement: Phase 1 provider matrix, backend identity oracle, deep-link/lifecycle replay, exact version research

records.question: How can phone OTP remain deterministic and safe in E2E?
records.applicableRange: Current Supabase CLI config and phone login documentation checked 2026-07-22
records.conclusion: Use auth.sms.test_otp mappings for isolated deterministic tests and keep real SMS as a bounded provider canary. Production needs an SMS provider, rate limits, CAPTCHA/abuse controls, country/regulatory review, and secret injection outside source and evidence.
records.contradiction: Real SMS delivery is costly and nondeterministic, so it must not be the only CI oracle.
records.enforcement: fixed non-production OTP fixtures, secret-safe config, rate/spend preflight, real-SMS canary budget

records.question: What are the platform boundaries for Apple and Google login?
records.applicableRange: Current Expo, Apple, Android and Supabase documentation checked 2026-07-22
records.conclusion: Use native Sign in with Apple on iOS and native/provider-correct Google flows on installed iOS and Android builds. Apple on Android is a separate OAuth/Services-ID capability with additional redirect and secret-rotation operations. Social provider canaries require real external identity evidence.
records.contradiction: Expo AppleAuthentication supports iOS rather than Android; an Android Apple flow therefore has a different native/operational contract and must not be inferred from iOS.
records.enforcement: platform-specific adapters, capability flags, native builds, real-provider canaries, portal metadata preflight

records.question: What deletion behavior is required when the boilerplate creates accounts?
records.applicableRange: Current Apple App Review and Google Play account-deletion guidance checked 2026-07-22
records.conclusion: The base app needs an in-app account-deletion path. Apple-linked accounts require Apple token revocation. Google Play additionally requires a functional external web resource where users can request account and associated-data deletion.
records.contradiction: Logout, deactivation, or support email alone is not equivalent to complete account deletion for a normal consumer app.
records.enforcement: account-deletion scenario, recent-auth step, backend cascade oracle, Apple revocation proof, release configuration gate

records.question: Can identities from different auth methods always be merged automatically?
records.conclusion: No. Supabase can automatically link verified identities with the same email and offers manual linking as beta, but phone-only, Apple private-relay, unverified and unrelated identities require an explicit collision/linking policy to avoid account takeover.
records.contradiction: A normalized session contract does not imply that all external identifiers belong to one person or should share one backend user ID.
records.enforcement: collision scenarios, verified-linking policy, manual linking excluded until separately approved
